reviews.x: Bought this on a whim because I have one that is upf 50 that I wear in the sun to protect my hair that fits perfectly, and several that I bought to wear in the house that all slipped out of my hair. This one does not slip like the other one even though it's made of a similar material. The only down side is that it has no sun protection, but other than that - love it!

I am a huge Wonder Woman fan so when I saw this I had to get it. I was looking for something to possibly wear as headband or scarf when I work out. It's made different than I thought, which I like! It is soft so it won't snag your hair ( I have coarse, dry hair that breaks easily) and it's easy to slip on ( there's nothing to tie). I wore it as a scarf around my face when it was really cold outside and it was comfortable! I ordered the Batman print for my 12 year old daughter and she loves it. C

Love how versatile this is. I thought it was just a standard scarf but you don't have to tie it, you just slip it on. I've worn it in the cold weather over my mouth and nose and it is very comfortable. The material is soft, doesn't irritate my sensitive skink or snag my very curly, rough hair.
Used this as a scarf for Tropicalia and it was perfect! I’ve also used this as a face mask to cover my face from dirt or even when I go to the airport. Cute and stylish at a great price!

While it is very stretchy and of course Batman I don’t recommend buying this. I bought it thinking it was like a different type of head wrap but it’s not. It’s pretty much a baklava face wrap that you put on your head. And I don’t like that. It’s impossible to figure out to even wear it or use it cause you’re limited to what you can and can’t do with it. I would also describe it as like a very stretchy bandana. It doesn’t even stay in place either. I’m very disappointed with this product.

It's as expected in that it's a cute head wrap, but it's purple where it should be red. Any actual Wonder Woman fan is aware that her colors are red and gold along with blue and white. No purple anywhere in there. Luckily, I adore purple, but it was still disappointing because I bought this to wear with an outfit to the movie premier and couldn't.
The Joy my son has wearing this hair wrap has been the highlight of our day/night. Just seeing him act silly and trying different styles of wearing it has been fun to watch!

reviews.t: It stays on when you sleep with it
reviews.x: My MIL loves betty boop, she uses this head wrap when she sleeps after getting her hair done and she loves it. She says it stays on all night.

reviews.t: Very comfortable. Bought for the chemo months
reviews.x: Very comfortable.  Bought for the chemo months.  I wear this under warmer hats and take the outer hat off during hot flashes.

reviews.t: this is a great product except for the one size fit most
reviews.x: this is a great product except for the one size fit most. It is just too tight and squeezed on my head.
I really love this. It is very soft and wonderfully stretchy. I'm really very happy with my purchase.
Love this headband. You can turn it into multiple things. My favorite thing to keep in my purse.
It matches my other batman stuff. It hasnt ripped up and didnt fade when i washed it.  5 stars.

reviews.t: Not a substitute for a mask
reviews.x: Not thick enough to use as a mask but great for everything else.

reviews.t: KEEPS MY CURLS IN ORDER WHILE I SLEEP!
reviews.x: Multi-useful for sure. I use them to hold my fragile curls in place so they don't get destroyed while I sleep. Stretch it really wide to go over my hair, and when it's all on my neck, slide the top part up till it is straight up from my neck to the top with a little bit left over up there.Slippery though so I still have to use 4 bobby pins to keep it on all night. Bought it in several designs as well.

My daughter loves this! She is a performer and often wears it on stage in her hair as a band to hold her hair back. The colors are good and goes with a variety of colors and styles she wears. The craftsmanship is good and should hold up to a lot of wear. Has a good stretch to the band. The price is slightly high, but it is a good product.

Was hesitant at first because of the price, but now that I purchased it for my 12 year old daughter, it was well worth the price. Came on time, courteous note came with it, and my daughter wears it all the time there are so many ways to use It! She loves it.

My daughter  needs super hero theme for  one of the days gymnastics camp and since she did have a Leo that matched a super hero we got this. It's really soft and good quality. It held her hair in place while she trained for 8 hours that day.

reviews.t: Great way to keep you hair out of your face
reviews.x: I bought this for my sister who suffers from seizures and regular headbands will bring them on. My niece has started using them because regular head bands give her headaches but these do not.
I bought this for my sister for Christmas. She had it on her wish list. It arrived a week before it was due. A plus. My sister lives the hair wrap. She wears it everyday. Couldn't be happier.
this headwrap/headband is everything I wanted and more! super soft material and beautiful design! Wear it all the time for work (13 hour shifts) and comfortable the whole way through.
Gave this to my friend for Christmas (well..after Christmas..it showed up a little late) she loves it, she loves Wonder Woman and she has ALOT of hair..this works great for her!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the soft, stretchy material that doesn't snag or irritate hair and skin.
Many customers highlight its versatility, using it as a scarf, headband, face cover, or sleep wrap.
Several reviewers say it stays in place, including overnight while sleeping.
A few customers complain about fit or sizing, saying it is too tight or hard to figure out how to wear.
Some reviewers note color or material discrepancies from expectations, such as purple instead of red or not thick enough for a mask.
